title: Cosmos3-Edge Runtime Provenance Record
description: Provenance record for a Cosmos3-Edge benchmark or inference run. Additive to native_benchmark_result.schema.json; does not replace CR2 fields. Fields marked 'unresolved until hardware' must be populated during Phase 2 on Jetson AGX Thor.

edge_llm_commit.description: Exact TensorRT Edge-LLM git commit SHA used to build the engines.

edge_llm_version.description: TensorRT Edge-LLM release tag if available, e.g. '0.10.0'.

runtime_strategy.description: Runtime strategy. 'cosmos3_edge_vlm' for the base scene-understanding checkpoint; 'cosmos3_policy_inference' for Policy-DROID (not used by this project).

component_identities.description: Per-component identity records. Keys are component names (e.g. 'llm', 'visual').

engine_dir.description: Absolute path to the TensorRT engine directory for this component.

engine_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the primary engine file, if available.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the engine config.json, if available.

temporal_input.description: Description of the video/temporal input submitted to the model.

fps.description: Frame rate of submitted video in frames per second.

input_mode.description: How frames are packaged. 'native_video' stacks frames into a single ImageData with temporal metadata. 'image_list' is legacy independent-frame mode (not used for Cosmos3-Edge).

task_mode.description: Output modality. 'text_reasoning' for scene-understanding/spatial-reasoning output; 'action_policy' for robot joint-space actions (Policy-DROID only).

cosmos3_native_stages.description: Native stage names reported by the Cosmos3-Edge runtime profiler. Populated during Phase 2 hardware execution. Null until then. Do not substitute CR2 stage names ('vision', 'prefill', 'generation') here.

timing.description: Timing measurements. All values in milliseconds. Populated during Phase 2.

stage_timings_ms.description: Per-stage latency keyed by cosmos3_native_stages names.

engine_profile_id.description: Engine profile identifier from engine_profiles.json, e.g. 'cosmos3-edge-thor-f8'.

build_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the TensorRT engines were built.

run_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this inference run occurred.
